papers.title: Follow the technology or follow the leader? Radical innovation and strategic leadership at a crossroads
papers.abstract: Radical innovation and strategic leadership research share a foundational challenge of theorizing how firms make choices about an uncertain future that shape their competitiveness, survival, and long-term performance. Yet, each field has developed a distinct explanatory signature. Radical innovation research has followed the technology, tracing how the architecture and trajectories of technological discontinuities determine organizational fates. Strategic leadership research has followed the leader, exploring how executives' cognition, values and behavioral tendencies shape strategic choices. This paper bridges these two fields by proposing an integrated framework in which technological trajectories and leadership agency are mutually constitutive.
papers.summary_ja: ラジカルイノベーション研究と戦略的リーダーシップ研究の理論的分断を架橋し、技術軌跡とリーダーの意思決定が相互規定する複合フレームワークを提唱する概念論文。長期イノベーション戦略の設計者に理論的基盤を提供する。
papers.analysis_unit: 概念論文（急進的イノベーション研究と戦略的リーダーシップ研究の統合）

papers.title: A Paradox Perspective on Business Model Innovation in Sustainability‐Oriented Industries: A Longitudinal Case Study in the Energy Sector
papers.abstract: This study examines how Business Model Innovation (BMI) unfolds in sustainability-oriented industries, where institutional complexity, technological interdependence, and environmental imperatives generate persistent sustainability-related paradoxical tensions. Drawing on a longitudinal case of a European system integrator in renewable energy and electric mobility, based on interviews and internal documentation, we trace how a strategic-level paradox propagates across organizational layers—a 'paradox cascade'—and how firms develop paradox intelligence to sustain BMI under persistent tensions.
papers.summary_ja: 再生可能エネルギー・電動モビリティ産業の欧州システムインテグレーターを対象に、BMIにおける「逆説カスケード」現象を縦断的に解明する。持続可能性志向B2B企業のビジネスモデル変革設計に直接活用できる知見を提供する。
papers.analysis_unit: 欧州の再生可能エネルギー・電動モビリティのシステムインテグレーター1社の縦断的事例研究（インタビューと社内文書）

papers.title: Organizing (in) innovation ecosystems: a definition, new theoretical lenses and a research agenda
papers.abstract: This paper repositions innovation ecosystems as an organizational phenomenon rather than primarily a structural arrangement. By foregrounding ecosystem organizing, it addresses persistent definitional ambiguity and develops a processual definition of innovation ecosystems that captures how coordination is practically accomplished and recurrently renegotiated across heterogeneous actors, technologies and institutional contexts. Drawing on organizational theory, practice theory and institutional theory, the paper proposes three new theoretical lenses: coordination dynamics, boundary fluidity, and institutional embeddedness.
papers.summary_ja: イノベーション・エコシステムを固定的構造ではなく「組織化プロセス」として再定義し、異種アクター間の調整がいかに実践的に遂行・交渉されるかを記述する3つの理論レンズを提案する概念論文。
papers.analysis_unit: 概念論文（イノベーションエコシステムのプロセス的定義と3つの理論レンズの提示）

papers.title: Algorithmic Status Inequality Through a Dynamic Capabilities Lens: A Market‐Based Perspective
papers.abstract: This paper accepts Wu's core observations on algorithmic status inequality while offering a complementary theoretical lens grounded in the dynamic capabilities framework and the economics of general-purpose technologies. Where Wu emphasizes structural constraint and reproduction, this Counterpoint emphasizes the mechanisms by which incumbent and challenger firms can develop, deploy, and reconfigure dynamic capabilities to compete in algorithmically mediated markets.
papers.summary_ja: DC理論の創始者Teece自身がアルゴリズムによる地位不平等をダイナミック・ケイパビリティと汎用技術経済学から分析し、AI時代の競争メカニズムを論じる注目論文。
papers.analysis_unit: 概念論文（Wu論文へのカウンターポイント、ダイナミックケイパビリティと汎用技術経済学の視点）

papers.title: Strategic leadership and organizational design: a review and research agenda
papers.authors: Clemens M. Brandstätter and Lorenz Graf-Vlachy
papers.abstract: Strategic leaders shape organizations. Besides decisions on strategic direction, growth ambitions, or cost structure, their choice of organizational design lays the foundation for company performance. Although organizational design has been widely studied, work linking strategic leadership to organizational design remains dispersed across multiple perspectives, limiting cumulative understanding of this relationship. In this systematic literature review, we synthesize existing research on how strategic leaders influence organizational design decisions and outcomes.
papers.summary_ja: 戦略的リーダーシップと組織設計の交点を系統的文献レビューで整理し、リーダーが組織設計選択を通じて企業パフォーマンスに影響するメカニズムとフューチャーリサーチアジェンダを提示する。
papers.analysis_unit: 系統的文献レビュー（対象文献数の記載なし）

papers.title: Simulating strategic interactions with AI agents
papers.abstract: We explore how Large Language Models (LLMs) can serve as synthetic subjects to inform strategy research. We introduce a framework for designing and running simulated experiments with LLM-powered agents. We argue that this approach is useful for rapid, low-cost prototyping of human experiments and for generating novel hypotheses. We apply the framework to the exploration-exploitation dilemma and show that LLM-based experiments reproduce patterns observed among human participants.
papers.summary_ja: LLMを「合成被験者」として戦略的相互作用（探索—活用ジレンマ）をシミュレートする新手法を提案し、人間実験と同様のパターンを再現できることを示す方法論論文。戦略シミュレーションへのAI活用に道を開く。
papers.analysis_unit: LLMエージェントを用いたシミュレーション実験（探索-活用ジレンマ）

papers.title: Frontline Manager AI Readiness and the Implementation of AI in the Frontlines
papers.abstract: Frontline managers are critical conduits of top-down AI initiatives, such as the implementation of AI systems. Yet, little research explores their role as catalysts or bottlenecks in such implementation initiatives. Using a theories-in-use approach, we tap into the mental models of 51 frontline managers and top management executives tasked with implementing AI initiatives.
papers.summary_ja: フロントラインマネジャー51名への質的調査でAI実装における中間管理職の「触媒者」対「ボトルネック」役割を検討し、「AIレディネス」の構成要素を同定する実証研究。日本企業のAI導入変革管理に直接適用可能。
papers.analysis_unit: フロントラインマネジャー・経営幹部51名の質的調査（theories-in-use アプローチ）

papers.title: Systems Thinking in Practice (STiP): A Praxeology for Our Times
papers.abstract: Peter Checkland's groundbreaking work on soft systems has been central to reframing understanding of human activity systems and emphasising the role of people in decision making. In this paper we explore some early influences on Checkland which led to the shift of systemicity to the process of inquiry into the world and also the framing choices resulting in a trap of human activity systems. We introduce Systems Thinking in Practice (STiP) as a praxeology—a systematic theory of practice oriented around the practitioner.
papers.summary_ja: ChecklandのSSM（ソフトシステム方法論）の系譜を批判的に検討し、「ハード／ソフト」の二元論をデュアリティ（対）へ再枠組み化することで、実践者と実践知（プラクシス）を中心に据える「STiPプラクシオロジー」を提唱する。オープン大学の55年にわたる教育・研究経験に基づき、システム思考を方法論中心から実践の学へ移すことを求める論文。
papers.analysis_unit: 概念・レビュー（オープン大学の教育研究経験にもとづく批判的省察）

papers.title: Direct and indirect customer orientation in multi-sided platforms: a stakeholder perspective
papers.authors: Nour Osama Morsy Mohamed et al.
papers.abstract: Customer orientation (CO) theory has developed largely within a firm-centric frame, leaving open how it is enacted and coordinated across independent actors in multi-sided platforms (MSPs). This study develops and empirically specifies two complementary CO forms—direct customer orientation (DCO) and indirect customer orientation (ICO)—and examines how their interplay generates synergies or conflicts. A qualitative single case study of Airbnb combines platform documentation and interview data.
papers.summary_ja: Airbnbのケーススタディで、マルチサイドプラットフォームにおける「直接的顧客志向（DCO）」と「間接的顧客志向（ICO）」の2形態を提案し、複数ステークホルダー調整メカニズムを解明するサービス経営論文。
papers.analysis_unit: Airbnb1社の質的単一事例研究（プラットフォーム文書とインタビューデータ）

papers.title: Colours within planetary boundaries? Applying the Three Horizons framework to a critical review of natural dyes in the textile industry sustainability transformation
papers.abstract: As a fossil-dependent industrial system, the fashion and textile industry is operating outside safe planetary boundaries and requires a systemic sustainability transformation. This review focuses on natural textile colourants with two complementing aims: to examine how the present and future of natural colourants are discussed in the research literature, and to explore how these framings situate natural colourants in the larger context of a sustainability transformation, applying the Three Horizons framework.
papers.summary_ja: テキスタイル産業の持続可能性転換という文脈で、天然染料・天然色材に関する文献を再帰的主題分析とThree Horizons（3H）フレームワークで読み解いた批判的レビュー。天然色材は既存実践を問い直す再興領域である一方、合成染料の支配と消費者・生産者のマインドセット固定に阻まれており、（インフラ）構造とマインドセット双方のロックインおよびトレードオフの直視が必要と論じる。3Hを実際の素材領域に適用した具体例として参考になる。
papers.analysis_unit: 天然染料・天然色材に関する文献の批判的レビュー
